section.title: org.osgi.service.cdi.runtime.dto.template
section.para: CDI Integration Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:

listitem.para: ActivationTemplateDTO - Activations represent either immediate instances or service objects produced by component instances.
ComponentTemplateDTO - A static description of a CDI component.

ConfigurationTemplateDTO - A description of a configuration dependency of a component
The content of this DTO is resolved form metadata at initialization time and remains the same between the CDI bundle restarts.
ContainerTemplateDTO - Description of a CDI container.
ExtensionTemplateDTO - Models an extension dependency of the ContainerDTO
ReferenceTemplateDTO - A description of a reference dependency of a component

section.title: public class ActivationTemplateDTO extends DTO
section.para: Activations represent either immediate instances or service objects produced by component instances.
The content of this DTO is resolved form metadata at initialization time and remains the same between the CDI bundle restarts.

section.title: public Map<String, Object> properties
section.para: The default properties for activations which represent container component services. This will never be populated for single or factory components.
These are merged (and possibly replaced) with runtime properties.
Must not be null. May be empty if no default properties are provided.

section.title: public ServiceScope scope
section.para: The ServiceScope of this activation
Must not be null.

section.title: public List<String> serviceClasses
section.para: Describes the set of fully qualified names of the interfaces/classes under which this activation will publish and OSGi service
Must not be null. An empty array indicated this activation will not publish an OSGi service

section.title: public class ComponentTemplateDTO extends DTO
section.para: A static description of a CDI component.

At runtime it is spit between a ComponentInstanceDTO which handles the resolution of the configurations, references and the creation of ComponentInstanceDTO instances and one or more ComponentInstanceDTO instances, which handle the resolution of references and the creation of activations.

section.title: public List<ActivationTemplateDTO> activations
section.para: The activations associated with the component.
Must not be null.

section.title: public List<String> beans
section.para: The set of beans that make up the component.
Must not be null.

section.title: public List<ConfigurationTemplateDTO> configurations
section.para: The configuration dependencies of this component.
There is always at least one default singleton configuration.
May contain at most one factory configuration.
Must not be null.

section.title: public String name
section.para: A name unique within the container.
Must not be null.

section.title: public Map<String, Object> properties
section.para: The default component properties.
These are merged (and possibly replaced) with runtime properties.
Must not be null. May be empty if no default properties are provided.

section.title: public List<ReferenceTemplateDTO> references
section.para: The service dependencies of the component.
The list will be empty if there are no service dependencies.
Must not be null.

section.title: public ComponentType type
section.para: The type of the component.
Must not be null.

section.title: public class ConfigurationTemplateDTO extends DTO
section.para:
A description of a configuration dependency of a component
The content of this DTO is resolved form metadata at initialization time and remains the same between the CDI bundle restarts.

section.title: public MaximumCardinality maximumCardinality
section.para: The maximum cardinality of the configuration dependency.

listitem.para: When MaximumCardinality.ONE this is a singleton configuration dependency.
When MaximumCardinality.MANY this is a factory configuration dependency.

section.para: Must not be null.

section.title: public String pid
section.para: The PID of the tracked configuration object(s).
Must not be null.

section.title: public ConfigurationPolicy policy
section.para: The policy for the configuration dependency.
Must not be null.

section.title: public class ContainerTemplateDTO extends DTO
section.para: Description of a CDI container.

section.title: public List<ComponentTemplateDTO> components
section.para: The components defined in this CDI container.
Must not be null
Has at lest one element for the container component. See Container Component.

section.title: public List<ExtensionTemplateDTO> extensions
section.para: The extension dependencies of this CDI container.
Must not be null
May be empty if the CDI container does not require CDI extensions.

section.title: public String id
section.para: The id of the CDI container.

section.title: public class ExtensionTemplateDTO extends DTO
section.para: Models an extension dependency of the ContainerDTO

section.title: public String serviceFilter
section.para: The service filter used for finding the extension service.
The value must be associated to the osgi.cdi extender requirement whose 'extension' attribute contains a value equal to serviceFilter.
Must not be null.

section.title: public class ReferenceTemplateDTO extends DTO
section.para: A description of a reference dependency of a component
The content of this DTO is resolved form metadata at initialization time and remains the same between the CDI bundle restarts.

section.title: public MaximumCardinality maximumCardinality
section.para: The maximum cardinality of the reference.

section.title: public int minimumCardinality
section.para: The minimum cardinality of the reference.
Contains the minimum cardinality statically resolved from the CDI bundle metadata. The minimum cardinality can be replaced by configuration at runtime.

listitem.para: If maximumCardinality is ONE the value must be either 0 or 1.
If maximumCardinality is MANY the value must be from 0 to Integer.MAX_VALUE.

section.title: public String name
section.para: A unique within the container and persistent across reboots identified for this activation
The value must not be null. The value must be equal to the reference name.

section.title: public ReferencePolicy policy
section.para: Indicates if the reference is dynamic or static in nature.

section.title: public ReferencePolicyOption policyOption
section.para: Indicates if the reference is greedy or reluctant in nature.

section.title: public String serviceType
section.para: Indicates the type of service matched by the reference.
The value must not be null.

section.title: public String targetFilter
section.para: Indicates a target filter used in addition to the serviceType to match services.
Contains the target filter resolved from the CDI bundle metadata. The filter can be replaced by configuration at runtime.
